aegis.dev/documentation/1.0.purpose: Provide named, repeatable configure/build/test workflows for developers and CI without shell-specific setup. JSON comments are forbidden, so this supported vendor metadata documents the file itself.

configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Shared Ninja configuration inherited by every visible profile; centralizes strict warnings, tests, benchmarks, and compile-command export.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Debug configuration used for the normal edit-build-test loop.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized configuration used to run representative benchmarks.

configurePresets.name: asan-ubsan
configurePresets.description: Debug configuration that detects invalid memory access and undefined behavior; benchmarks are excluded to keep the check focused.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Debug configuration that detects data races; it stays separate because TSan cannot be combined with ASan.

configurePresets.name: format
configurePresets.description: Minimal configuration that creates formatting targets without downloading tests or benchmarks.

buildPresets.name: dev
buildPresets.description: Build every target produced by the developer configuration.

buildPresets.name: release
buildPresets.description: Build the optimized library, tests, and benchmark harness.

buildPresets.name: asan-ubsan
buildPresets.description: Build unit tests instrumented with ASan and UBSan.

buildPresets.name: tsan
buildPresets.description: Build unit tests instrumented with TSan.

buildPresets.name: format
buildPresets.description: Build a selected formatting target from the minimal format configuration.

testPresets.name: dev
testPresets.description: Run developer-profile tests, print failures, and fail if no tests were registered.

testPresets.name: release
testPresets.description: Run optimized-profile tests before accepting benchmark output.

testPresets.name: asan-ubsan
testPresets.description: Run tests under address and undefined-behavior instrumentation.

workflowPresets.name: verify
workflowPresets.description: Execute the complete developer verification sequence in the required order.

workflowPresets.name: benchmark
workflowPresets.displayName: Configure, build, and test the release profile
workflowPresets.description: Prepare a validated optimized build; tools/run_benchmarks.py records the measurements separately.

workflowPresets.name: verify-asan-ubsan
workflowPresets.displayName: Configure, build, and test with ASan and UBSan
workflowPresets.description: Execute the full test sequence with memory and undefined-behavior checks enabled.

workflowPresets.name: verify-tsan
workflowPresets.displayName: Configure, build, and test with TSan
workflowPresets.description: Execute the full test sequence with data-race detection enabled.
